full_name: Julia Adeney Thomas | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 History Joy Foundation Fellow University of Notre Dame
bio: Julia Adeney Thomas is an associate professor in the Department of History at the University of Notre Dame. Bringing critical theory to bear on questions of power in modern societies, Thomas investigates concepts of nature in Japanese political ideology, the impact of environmental history on historiography, and photography as a political practice.
